Bunnelby

Normal

Kalos · Generation 6

Bunnelby is a Normal-type Digging Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 5 kg. It evolves into Diggersby. Its highest base stat is Speed (57), with a base stat total of 237.
